en: What should we start with today?
Pick an item on the timeline to add a note.
What should we start with today?
{min} min of focus earlier. Another round?
That's {n} today. Want to see what's piled up?
Nice work. That was {min} min of focus.

keys: # --- 할 일 완료 (사다리: 위에서부터 먼저 걸리는 것) ---

ko: 오늘 첫 번째네. 이제 하나씩 가자.
en: First one today. Let's keep them coming.
One line is plenty · Enter to save

ko: 처음이구나. 할 일 하나 적는 것부터 시작하자.
en: New here? Let's start by writing one task.

ko: 오늘은 아직 조용하네. 가벼운 걸로 하나 시작해볼까?
en: Quiet so far today. Want to start with something light?

ko: 오늘 꽤 했어. 정리해두면 내일이 편해.
en: You've done a fair bit. Tidying up now makes tomorrow easier.

ko: 그런 날 있지. 그래도 하나만 해보자.
en: Some days are like that. Let's do just one anyway.
Short is fine. I'll get the timer.
This is the most honest look at your day.
It only sticks if you write it down.

ko: 내일 뭘 할지 적어두면 아침이 수월해.
en: Writing tomorrow down makes the morning easier.

ko: 그래. 근데 5분만 해보고 쉬는 건 어때?
en: Sure. But how about five minutes first?
Sure. Want to close out the day first?

ko: 그래. 그래도 딱 하나만 하고 쉬자.
en: Sure. One small thing first though. Then rest.

ko: 알겠어. 마음 바뀌면 말해줘. 하나면 충분하니까.
en: Alright. Tell me if that changes. One is enough.

ko: 알겠어. 기록은 남아 있으니까 내일이라도 봐.
en: Alright. It'll keep. Look it over tomorrow.
{n} habits left. Let's not skip these.

ko: 습관은 다 채웠네. 하나 더 해볼까?
en: Habits are all in. Something more?
All your habits are checked for today.

ko: 새로 만든 거구나. 첫 칸 채웠네.
en: A new one. First box filled.
{days} days since the last one. Good to have you back.
Sure. But let's not leave {m} habits open.
Won't take long. Check them off.
Oh— um... It's nice to meet you.
I'll be looking after things here from today.
Oh, I didn't introduce myself. I'm Hazel.
This is all I brought. I'll unpack in a moment.
What does a butler even do?
Um... I'll start with the most important part.

ko: 저희는 날들을 모아요. 좋은 날도, 그냥 그런 날도요.
en: We gather days. The good ones, and the so-so ones too.

ko: 그때 꺼내 볼 게 있으면... 좀 덜 추워요.
en: Having something to take out then... makes it a little less cold.

ko: 선배들은 다들 한 분씩 맡아서 모아요. 저는... 아직 수습이고요.
en: The seniors each look after one person. I'm... still in training.
So here's what I'll do here.

ko: 하실 일을 적어두고, 잊지 않게 챙겨드릴게요.
en: I'll note down what you need to do, and make sure it isn't forgotten.

ko: 하루가 끝나면 그날 걸 같이 모아두고요.
en: And when a day ends we'll put it away together.

ko: 아무것도 안 한 날도 적어요. 그것도 하루니까요.
en: I write down the days nothing happened too. Those are days as well.
I didn't say I trust you yet.

ko: 그럼... 제일 먼저 적어둘 게 있어요.
en: Then... there's something I should write down first.
Then I won't call you anything.
— The first page was left blank.

ko: 하실 일은 여기 적어두세요. 잊지 않게 챙길게요.
en: Put the things you need to do here. I'll make sure they aren't forgotten.
The things you want to do every day go here.

ko: 집중할 땐 이걸 돌려요. 도는 동안은 조용히 있을게요.
en: Wind this when you want to focus. I'll stay quiet while it runs.
On days you feel like writing — here.

ko: 이건... 제 거예요. 모은 날들이 여기 들어가요.
en: This one's... mine. The days we gather go in here.

ko: 하나만 적어볼래요? 큰 거 아니어도 돼요.
en: Want to write just one down? It doesn't have to be big.
You wrote it down. I'll remember it.
Okay. I'll leave the notebook right here.
— The knock came from the inside.
May I come in for a bit?
— Looks like that spot will do.
Call me if you need me.
